rationale.text: The html element has neither lang nor xml:lang, and no element of the page carries a language indication. The paragraphs are ordinary visible text in a generic sans-serif family, black on white. The test is met only if the indication is given for the html element or on each text element or one of its parents; neither holds for these paragraphs, whichever texts are counted as text elements. The custom check faults on the first uncovered witness (step 3), through a link whose fault means failure, so the finding is failed at both levels. axe's html-has-lang also faults, as evidence only.

citations.quote: Pour chaque page web, l’indication de langue par défaut vérifie-t-elle une de ces conditions
L’indication de la langue de la page (attribut `lang` et/ou `xml:lang`) est donnée pour l’élément `html`
L’indication de la langue de la page (attribut `lang` et/ou `xml:lang`) est donnée sur chaque élément de texte ou sur l’un des éléments parents.
